item: reconcile the 41-vs-130 dwarven lexicon discrepancy (a06's unreconciled finding): tools/df_words.json 41 entries vs ArtifactLore.luau DWARVEN pool 130 entries
note: Root cause: df_words.json is a stale era receipt, not a generator output. It was banked at birth (commit 65c4af34a, '2122 words, 41 banked', wiki-mine era), stayed 41 entries ever since, and has ZERO code consumers (grep over roblox/ tools/ mag/ corpus/df_mine/ = 0 hits). No committed parser builds it (corpus/df_mine/ holds parse_entities.py, parse_spheres.py, build_df_procedural.py only). ArtifactLore's 130 (80 nouns + 50 adjectives) is current: folded from corpus/df_mine/df_lexicon_full.json in commit 37de3d3f9 (local-install mine, 3223 dwarf entries, POS via language_words.txt join, CP437). Resolution chosen: document, do not regenerate. Regeneration was refused because there is no committed parser to re-run, the 41 was a curation ('banked') not a filter output, and no code reads the file, so regenerating would invent a contract. Validation: all 130 pool entries verified word+POS grounded against df_lexicon_full dwarf (130/130; 0 POS disagreements; the 4 initial lookup misses were my probe script stripping suffixes, the mine holds them verbatim under keys 'ring object', 'rootverb', 'spring noun', 'spring season'). All 41 df_words entries are grounded in the mine too: 37 appear verbatim in the 130 pool, the other 4 (copper gusil, river iger, water arel, whisper iklist) match the full mine but were not carried into the pool; 0 entries absent from the mine. Alignment: added a provenance comment to roblox/src/shared/ArtifactLore.luau naming df_lexicon_full.json as the pool source and marking tools/df_words.json as the superseded wiki-era bank. Comment-only, 0 behavior change, entry count still 130; the_mountain.rbxlx not rebuilt in this lane (a02/gate owns rebuilds, rojo off PATH here) so its embedded copy is one comment behind until the next gate pass. Negatives first-class: no POS mismatches found (0); no unfounded pool entries (0); df_words.json deliberately NOT deleted (era receipt, zero consumers, deletion out of mandate); mountain_check not run by this lane; pre-existing em-dash in ArtifactLore.luau line 2 left untouched (not filed text, not introduced by this lane); all new filed lines are em-dash free.

decision_changed: Refused the regenerate branch: a06's framing ('was df_words built from a filtered subset?') resolved as neither filtered nor stale-by-drift but a superseded curation receipt from the wiki era, replaced wholesale by df_lexicon_full.json; the live truth is ArtifactLore, and the fix is documentation + provenance alignment, not a new df_words.json.
next_steal: Generated-data law gap: DfGoods.luau and RcpData.luau carry a regenerate command in their headers, but ArtifactLore.luau (130-entry pool) and Worldgen.luau (130 spheres) were hand-folded with no committed generator.
